statement: Valero Energy Corp's ethanol segment reported $153 million of operating income for the third quarter of 2024.
The ethanol segment's operating income decreased by $44 million in the third quarter of 2024 compared to the same period in 2023.

The AES Corporation completed the construction or acquisition of 3.0 GW of renewables in 2024, primarily in the United States and Chile, and completed the construction of a 670 MW combined cycle gas plant in Panama.
The AES Corporation retired 481 MW of coal generation in Chile and the United States, for a total of 13.4 GW of coal retired.
Teledyne Technologies Incorporated recorded a $49.5 million non-cash impairment charge for the FLIR indefinite-lived trademark in fiscal year 2024.
The FLIR indefinite-lived trademark had a carrying value of $685.3 million and a fair value of $635.8 million as of the annual assessment date.
The impairment charge for FLIR was based on a 7% discount from carrying value.
Amcor plc's Adjusted EBIT decreased by $7 million, or 12%, for the three months ended December 31, 2023, excluding positive currency impacts of $1 million.

The Adjusted EBIT decrease reflected a net negative effect of 29% from unfavorable volumes and favorable operating cost performance, partly offset by favorable price/mix of 17% for the three months ended December 31, 2023.

Sysco estimates lifetime expected credit losses for available-for-sale debt securities in an unrealized loss position by assessing credit indicators, including credit ratings, and records an allowance for expected credit loss through the consolidated results of operations if credit deterioration is identified.
Sysco records unrealized gains and losses on marketable securities in accumulated other comprehensive loss.
American Water Works Company, Inc. plans to invest approximately $3.3 billion in growth strategies in 2025, including capital investment in infrastructure and regulated acquisitions.

In the first three months of 2025, American Water Works Company, Inc. invested $518 million in the Regulated Businesses, including $515 million for infrastructure improvements and $3 million for an acquisition.
The $3 million acquisition in the Regulated Businesses added approximately 300 customers during the first three months of 2025.
Abbott Laboratories' COVID-19 testing-related sales were $84 million in the first quarter of 2025 compared to $204 million in the first quarter of 2024.
The decline in COVID-19 testing-related sales was partially attributed to volume-based procurement programs in China.
Texas Instruments Incorporated's Analog segment revenue decreased 11% in Q2 2024 compared with Q2 2023.
Texas Instruments Incorporated's Embedded Processing segment revenue decreased 31% in Q2 2024 compared with Q2 2023.
Tapestry, Inc. declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.35 per common share for FY2025 Q1, resulting in $80 million in dividend payments.
Domino's Pizza, Inc. defines team member engagement as the strength of the connection team members feel toward their work, teams, and the overall organization.
Domino's Pizza, Inc. uses business resource groups (BRGs) to engage team members through company-wide fireside chats, best practice sharing, and skill development.
Domino's Pizza, Inc. has established commitments to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, with near-term and net zero targets approved by the Science-Based Targets initiative (SBTi) in October 2024.
Digital Realty Trust, Inc.'s subsidiary Digital Dutch Finco B.V. issued €850 million of 3.875% Guaranteed Notes due 2035 in January 2025.
The net proceeds from the note issuance were approximately €838 million after deducting managers’ discounts and estimated offering expenses.
Lennox International Inc.'s Building Climate Solutions segment net sales increased 15% in the third quarter of 2024 compared to the same period in 2023.
The Building Climate Solutions segment's 15% revenue growth included 6% from inorganic growth due to the AES acquisition.
Vistra Corp. expects the nuclear PTC to contribute approximately $500 million to its 2024 PTC revenues, assuming an interpretation of gross receipts that excludes hedges from the calculation.
Vistra Corp. has not recognized any revenues or receivables related to the IRC Section 45U nuclear PTC through September 30, 2024, due to pending U.S. Treasury and Internal Revenue Service guidance.
Solventum Corporation recorded a pre-tax restructuring charge of $62 million in FY2024.

The restructuring charges for FY2024 were allocated across cost of product ($17 million), cost of software and rentals ($2 million), selling, general and administrative expenses ($36 million), and research and development expenses ($7 million).
Restructuring actions in FY2024 included $46 million in employee termination benefits and $16 million in asset-related and other charges.
As of December 31, 2024, Solventum had accrued liabilities of $53 million related to restructuring actions.
Borg Warner Inc's Drivetrain & Morse Systems net sales increased $28 million, or 1%, for the year ended December 31, 2024.
Borg Warner Inc's PowerDrive Systems net sales decreased $229 million, or 11%, for the year ended December 31, 2024.
Borg Warner Inc's Segment Adjusted Operating margin was 14.9% for the year ended December 31, 2024, compared to 14.5% in the year ended December 31, 2023.
Borg Warner Inc's Segment Adjusted Operating margin was 18.1% in the year ended December 31, 2024, compared to 17.3% in the year ended December 31, 2023.

Borg Warner Inc experienced a year-over-year decrease in sales of approximately $61 million due to foreign currency effects, primarily from the weakening of the Korean Won and Chinese Renminbi relative to the U.S. Dollar.
Borg Warner Inc's acquisitions contributed $27 million in additional sales during the year ended December 31, 2024.
Vulcan Materials Company expects a third consecutive year of double-digit year-over-year growth in Aggregates segment cash gross profit per ton in 2025, with an expected value of $10.61 in 2024.
The expected freight-adjusted aggregates unit cash cost in 2025 is projected to increase low to mid-single digits, as stated in the remarks.
LyondellBasell Industries N.V. faces pressure from rising energy costs in Europe, which may negatively impact European markets.
American Tower Corporation's attributable AFFO includes 25% from emerging markets.
PACCAR INC's Financial Services revenues were $528.0 million in 2025 compared to $509.3 million in 2024.
PACCAR INC's Financial Services group issued $694.6 million in medium-term notes during the first three months of 2025.
WEC Energy Group, Inc. is evaluating potential impacts of a possible nonattainment redesignation of Wisconsin areas on its operations.

WEC Energy Group, Inc. does not expect the new PM2.5 NAAQS standard to have a material impact on its units due to its transition from coal-fired to natural gas-fired and renewable generating facilities.
CME Group Inc.'s aggregate average daily contract volume increased 9% year-over-year from 2023 to 2024.
CME Group Inc.'s interest rate products saw a 10% year-over-year increase in average daily contract volume in 2024 compared to 2023.
CME Group Inc.'s energy products experienced a 17% year-over-year increase in average daily contract volume in 2024 compared to 2023.
CME Group Inc.'s metals products saw a 23% year-over-year increase in average daily contract volume in 2024 compared to 2023.
CME Group Inc.'s agricultural commodities business had a 13% year-over-year increase in average daily contract volume in 2024 compared to 2023.
CME Group Inc.'s foreign exchange products increased 8% in average daily contract volume year-over-year from 2023 to 2024.
Phillips 66 received cash proceeds of approximately $200 million from the sale of non-core midstream assets during the third quarter of 2024.

Synopsys, Inc.'s Design Automation segment includes advanced silicon design, verification products and services, system integration products, digital and custom FPGA IC design software, verification software and hardware products, system integration products and services, and manufacturing software products.

Synopsys, Inc.'s Design IP segment provides high-quality, silicon-proven IP solutions for system-on-chips (SoCs), particularly in the semiconductor and electronics industries, including markets such as mobile, automotive, digital home, internet of things, and cloud computing.
Arch Capital Group Ltd.'s reinsurance segment net premiums written increased 2.2% in FY2025 Q1 compared to FY2024 Q1.
The growth in net premiums written for Arch Capital Group Ltd.'s reinsurance segment was driven by increases in casualty, property catastrophe, and property excluding property catastrophe lines.
Net premiums earned for Arch Capital Group Ltd.'s reinsurance segment were 21.7% higher in FY2025 Q1 than in FY2024 Q1.
CSX Corporation's total revenue increased 1% in the third quarter 2024 compared to the third quarter 2023.
The revenue increase was primarily due to higher merchandise and intermodal volumes as well as pricing gains in merchandise.

Expedia Group, Inc. launched One Key in the United States in 2023 as a unified loyalty program under Brand Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo, enabling cross-earning and cross-redeeming of rewards across brands and products such as air, hotels, and alternative accommodations.
Expedia Group, Inc. plans to roll out One Key in the United Kingdom in 2024.
Quanta Services, Inc. reported second quarter revenues of $5.6 billion.
Net income attributable to common stock was $188.2 million for the second quarter.
Diluted earnings per share was $1.26 for the second quarter.
The AES Corporation's AES Indiana subsidiary has a TDSIC Plan approved by the IURC for $1.2 billion in eligible transmission, distribution, and storage system improvements from 2020 through 2026.
AES Indiana's TDSIC mechanism allows recovery of 80% of eligible costs through a periodic rate adjustment, with a 2% annual cap on total retail revenues.
As of December 31, 2024, AES Indiana had $138 million of TDSIC-eligible equipment net of depreciation and carrying cost approved for recovery.
Visa Inc.'s total workforce increased from approximately 28,800 in fiscal 2023 to approximately 31,600 in fiscal 2024, representing a 10% year-over-year growth.
Visa's voluntary workforce turnover (rolling 12-month attrition) was 5% as of September 30, 2024.

EXPAND ENERGY Corp redeemed all of the $304 million aggregate principal of the SWN 2028 Notes for approximately $312 million in a transaction during the fourth quarter of 2024, including an $8 million premium.
EXPAND ENERGY Corp repaid and terminated the $389 million aggregate principal of the SWN 2025 Notes on January 23, 2025, using cash on hand and borrowings from the Credit Facility.
Amcor plc's Flexibles Segment net sales decreased by $822 million, or 7%, in fiscal year 2024 compared to fiscal year 2023.

The decrease in Flexibles Segment net sales was primarily due to unfavorable sales volumes of 4%, reflecting lower market and customer demand and destocking, particularly in the first half of the year.
The Flexibles Segment's Adjusted EBIT decreased by $34 million, or 2%, in fiscal year 2024 compared to fiscal year 2023.
Lockheed Martin’s Aeronautics net sales increased $748 million, or 4%, in FY2024 Q3 compared to the same period in 2023.
The Aeronautics net sales increase was primarily due to higher sales on the F-16 program ($250 million), classified programs ($185 million), and the F-35 program ($160 million).
Aeronautics’ operating profit increased $25 million, or 1%, in FY2024 Q3 compared to 2023.
The operating profit increase was driven by $70 million from higher volume and program ramp up, partially offset by $35 million of lower profit booking rate adjustments.
The decrease in profit booking rate adjustments was due to $145 million of unfavorable adjustments on a classified program and an $85 million favorable adjustment for a C-5 Galaxy contract.
Nasdaq, Inc.'s Financial Technology segment total revenue increased 56.0% in the third quarter of 2024 compared with the same period in 2023.
The increase in Financial Technology segment revenue was driven by price increases, new sales to existing clients, and new customer acquisitions, particularly small and medium-sized businesses.
Biogen Inc. expects the IRA's Medicare Part D redesign to have a modest net unfavorable impact on 2025 revenue, ranging from approximately $50.0 million to $100.0 million.
The projected revenue impact from the IRA Medicare Part D redesign is concentrated in Biogen's SKYCLARYS and MS portfolio products, with approximately a third of the impact associated with SKYCLARYS.
Assurant, Inc.'s Global Housing Adjusted EBITDA increased 17% to $671.2 million for Twelve Months 2024 compared to $574.2 million for Twelve Months 2023.
The increase in Global Housing Adjusted EBITDA was primarily driven by growth in Homeowners, partially offset by $134.2 million of higher pre-tax reportable catastrophes.
Jack Henry & Associates, Inc.'s Services and Support revenue increased 4.5% for the third quarter of fiscal 2024 compared to the same quarter in fiscal 2023.
Jack Henry & Associates, Inc.'s Services and Support revenue increased 6.3% for the nine months ended March 31, 2024, compared to the same period in fiscal 2023.
Microsoft Corporation's Gaming revenue increased $2.7 billion or 32% in FY2024 Q2 compared to the prior period.
The increase in Gaming revenue was driven by 30 points of net impact from the Activision Blizzard acquisition.
Xbox content and services revenue increased 40% in FY2024 Q2.
Viatris will receive additional territory rights in Japan, South Korea, and certain other countries in the Asia-Pacific region for cenerimod under the letter agreement with Idorsia.
Viatris will see a $250 million reduction in contingent milestone payments, including $200 million of development milestones, as part of the letter agreement with Idorsia.
Viatris will assume $100 million of Idorsia’s obligation to contribute to development costs under the letter agreement.

Tyson Foods, Inc. uses derivative financial instruments, primarily forwards and options, to reduce the effect of changing commodity prices and to procure underlying commodities such as grains and livestock.
Tyson Foods, Inc. records unrealized gains and losses from non-designated or non-qualified derivative positions in earnings at each reporting date.
Vulcan Materials Company's Aggregates segment gross profit increased 18% to $357.3 million in FY2025 Q1.
Aggregates shipments decreased 1% compared to the prior year.
CarMax, Inc. purchased approximately 234,000 vehicles from consumers and dealers during the fourth quarter of fiscal 2024.
CarMax, Inc. purchased approximately 21,000 vehicles through dealers during the fourth quarter of fiscal 2024, up 44.8% from the prior year quarter.

Phillips 66's NGL business, including DCP Midstream Class A Segment, DCP Sand Hills Pipeline, LLC (DCP Sand Hills), and DCP Southern Hills, LLC (DCP Southern Hills), contains both fee-based operations and operations impacted by NGL and natural gas prices.
During the second quarter of 2024, the NGL composite barrel price increased compared with the second quarter of 2023, partially due to crude oil prices increasing over the same period.

The decrease in the composite 3:2:1 market crack spread for Phillips 66's Refining segment to an average of $18.96 per barrel during the second quarter of 2024 was primarily driven by higher crude oil costs and lower global prices for gasoline and diesel.
CSX Corporation's expenses increased $20 million, or 1%, in second quarter 2024 compared to second quarter 2023.
Labor and Fringe expense increased $18 million in second quarter 2024, with $23 million attributed to higher headcount and $18 million due to inflation.
Purchased Services and Other expense increased $8 million in second quarter 2024, primarily due to a $13 million increase from inflation.
Apple Inc.'s Services segment revenue reached $24.2 billion in FY2024 Q3, representing an all-time record and 14% year-over-year growth.

NRG Energy, Inc. executed Accelerated Share Repurchase agreements to repurchase $950 million of its outstanding common stock, concluding on March 28, 2024, with 18,839,372 shares received at an average price of $50.43 per share.

As of October 31, 2024, NRG Energy, Inc. had $2.0 billion remaining under its $3.7 billion share repurchase authorization, following $319 million of repurchases in the nine months ended September 30, 2024, and an additional $225 million through October 31, 2024.
